The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to achieve the best performance, it is necessary to fuse both types of inertial sensor measurements in both the measurement stage and the prediction stage.
the performance of different fusion strategies can differ substantially, depending on the application and the type of motion.

, when the goal is 3D camera tracking, the inertial sensor should be fused in the measurement stage of the EKF and that the choice of fusing accelerometer or gyroscope in the measurement stage depends on whether the 3D pose error or the camera reprojection error is more important.
